_comment: CANONICAL envelope (production recipe v3 ADOPTED 2026-06-11 per the Phase 13/15 re-judgment; see docs/band_obstacle_recall_evidence.md Phases 9-15 and docs/gt_free_verification.md; prior canonical artifacts at external/_pre_v3_artifacts_backup). The 2.5 cm voxel is PHYSICALLY derived, never from scene results: the robot's collision-relevant thin-structure class is furniture legs (chair/table legs ~3 cm cross-section, the canonical small obstacle the collision band exists for); a voxel edge larger than the structure's cross-section makes the structure a sub-voxel minority that cannot robustly claim even one voxel, so voxel <= ~3 cm; 0.025 m is the clean halving of the prior 0.05 m grid satisfying that bound, and keeps margin_m representable as exactly 2 voxels. Lever conversions at 2.5 cm: support 0.15 m = 6 voxels; occupancy_support_min_count stays 3 ABSOLUTE (unverified evidence keeps the same count bar; only multi-view-VERIFIED, perturbation-STABLE evidence reaches confidence at verified_surface_min_count = 2 = ceil(3/2.2), the once-fixed tier). Brief S2 adopted free_carve_discipline=truncated with unverified margin multiplier 1.5 as a fresh xyz-scoped falsifier: dangerous_free@5cm 0.111 <= 0.20 and free-recall retention 0.941 >= 0.60; desk remains reportage.
